title: 5 Unexpected Animal Skills, Ranked.

primary.title: 5 Unexpected Animal Skills, Ranked.
primary.description: Five real animal moments. One completely subjective ranking. A squirrel drops in, a hermit crab carries a broken shell, a starfish flips itself back over, an octopus opens a bottle, and a Tufted Titmouse lands on a human hand. Which one deserves number one? All picture clips are CC0 1.0 via Wikimedia Commons and are credited below. This is subjective entertainment, not a scientific claim or a claim about any individual animal's life.

comments.clarifying: This is a subjective entertainment ranking using independently licensed CC0 Wikimedia Commons clips; it is not a scientific claim or a claim about any individual animal's life.
